title: Packed GLiNER boundaries and local polarity
question: Do jointly scored exact candidates and predicate-local polarity offer a basis for adopting a challenger?
method: Replay retained exact windows using the pinned CPU boundary checkpoint and vary explicit span populations; compare the presence of one local attribute on authored diagnostic cases.
conclusion: Packed diagnostic scores were order-invariant on admitted authored cases. Several union and alignment refusals remain, and the polarity arm did not recover the intended predicates. No independent structure gain or mode change was established.
